title: Introducing Ernest Silver Trepagnier
summary: Allen records Silver Trepagnier's age, birth in 1899 and WPA work.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I will. Maybe we ought to get a little, uh, earnest on here too. Let's give it, let's give him a chance. Yeah, go ahead.
Don't talk that now. Yeah. I mean, I ain't talking about me on the drum out.
Okay. Now, we got your name down and you say you're no relation to the drum.
Yeah, I knew him. I worked with him.
You worked with him. Where did you work with him?
Oh, in the town of WPA. That's where I met him.
And what were you doing at the time?
Oh, we was, uh, cleaning out the City Park Index. I did something out there and done golf courses.
I see. Can we get your age now and your place of ours?
Yeah. All in the Orleans. 1899. 60 years old. Monday coming, I'll be 60.
Yeah, because of Columbus, the skull of America.
The three of us have the same birthday.
We always get together. Louis and Louise. Yeah. Louis Robesher and Louise. Yeah. Of course, I'm the worst. We celebrate our birthday every year. Three friends.
